title: Analysis code for functional transitions under persistent metabolic burden in CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA
description: Versioned statistical analysis code for coordinated CHARLS, HRS, and ELSA analyses of depressive symptoms, memory, and transitions into and out of ADL disability under persistent metabolic burden. Version 2.1.1 adds full baseline confounder adjustment, stabilized longitudinal response weighting, disability-or-death and stricter-ADL sensitivities, a model-aligned ELSA temporal-window analysis, and refreshed figure code. No participant-level data, derived data, numerical results, figures, or manuscript files are included.
